behaviour: A pile is a comment tag, and filing goes up the tree
when: tap a pile that sits inside other piles (e.g. Latin & World › Arabic › Post-Shaabi)
expect: the track gets the pile's tag AND every ancestor's tag; pile counts include tracks in any pile inside it; the NEW marker is dropped
howToTest: 1. open Latin & World › Arabic  2. tap Post-Shaabi  3. the In: row shows the full path; Latin & World's count went up by one

behaviour: Tapping a pile files the track and keeps it on the deck
when: tap a pile while a track is on the card
expect: the pile turns green with a tick, the same track stays on the card so it can go into more piles; tapping a ticked pile takes it out (and out of everything inside it)
howToTest: 1. tap House → green ✓, card unchanged  2. tap Disco → both ticked  3. tap House again → House un-ticked

expect: the track starts at ~30% of its length (intros rarely tell the genre); Next autoplays
howToTest: 1. press ▶ → the time reads roughly a third of the length  2. tap Next → the next track starts playing by itself
consideredRejected: WaveSurfer (crouton-audio) as the player → ❌ downloads the whole file before playing: no instant start, no autoplay inside an iOS tap, ~2× mobile data

behaviour: An In: row shows where the track is
expect: every deepest pile the track is in is shown as a full path with ×; non-pile tags (PMCP, Wedding…) show as grey chips
howToTest: 1. file a track into two piles → both appear as paths  2. tap × on one → it's removed

behaviour: Next continues from where the track was
when: file the current track (it leaves the inbox) and tap Next
expect: the deck moves to the track that now sits where the filed one was — not back to the top
howToTest: 1. pick the 5th inbox track from the list  2. file it  3. Next → the track that was 6th

when: make a change, reload the page, tap ↶ in the header
expect: the last change is reverted; history lives on the server, grouped per tap
howToTest: 1. file a track  2. reload  3. tap ↶ → it's out of the pile again
consideredRejected: in-memory undo stack → ❌ prototype showed 'nothing to undo' after a reload
crouton-events audit trail → ❌ best-effort async logging from the browser, no grouping, no undo

behaviour: Open a pile to see what's inside
expect: its sub-piles are shown; the header list holds tracks in that pile not yet in any sub-pile; breadcrumb / back arrow go up
howToTest: 1. tap › on House → its sub-piles  2. header shows 'Loose in House · N'  3. back arrow → top

behaviour: Search from the top finds every track
when: open the list at the top level and type
expect: matches come from the whole library, so filed tracks can be found and re-filed; inside a pile it searches that pile's list
howToTest: 1. at the top, open the list, type an artist you've already tagged → it's found  2. pick it → it's on the deck

expect: piles are one column of compact rows (a grid on wide screens); nothing scrolls sideways at 375px; built from stock Nuxt UI components
howToTest: 1. open on the iPhone → one column, no sideways scroll
